#{id}

SELECT i.id, i.appt_id, i.service_id, i.tech_id, i.room_id, i.price, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, t.user_id as t_user_id, t.real_name as t_real_name, r.id as r_id, r.name as r_name FROM ams_appointment_item i LEFT JOIN ams_service s ON i.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ams_technician_info t ON i.tech_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN ams_room r ON i.room_id = r.id WHERE i.appt_id = #{apptId}

SELECT i.id, i.appt_id, i.service_id, i.tech_id, i.room_id, i.price FROM ams_appointment_item i JOIN ams_appointment a ON i.appt_id = a.id WHERE i.tech_id = #{techId} AND a.end_time > #{minTime} AND a.status IN (1, 5)

SELECT a.id as apptId, a.start_time as startTime, a.end_time as endTime, s.name as serviceName, u.nickname as customerName FROM ams_appointment_item i JOIN ams_appointment a ON i.appt_id = a.id JOIN ams_service s ON i.service_id = s.id JOIN sys_user u ON a.customer_id = u.id WHERE i.tech_id = #{techId} AND a.end_time > #{minTime} AND a.status IN (1, 5) ORDER BY a.start_time ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM ams_appointment_item i JOIN ams_appointment a ON i.appt_id = a.id WHERE i.tech_id = #{techId} AND a.status IN (1, 5)
SELECT count(*) FROM ams_appointment_item WHERE service_id = #{serviceId}
SELECT count(*) FROM ams_appointment_item WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
